name: Polidog Patrol
original_name: ポリドッグパトロール
source:
You play as newbie police officer Shibakuro to solve various cases. Through seamless battles and exploring the expansive environment, you will fight the Gangs with your fellow senior officers.

[From the [url=https://www.untendo.com/product-page/%E3%83%9D%E3%83%AA%E3%83%89%E3%83%83%E3%82%B0%E3%83%91%E3%83%88%E3%83%AD%E3%83%BC%E3%83%AB-win%E7%89%88]official product site[/url]]​
translation:
你将扮演新晋警员柴默，解决各类案件。在广阔的环境中探索，通过无缝衔接的战斗，与前辈警员们携手打击帮派。
